tasks.label: Build & Deploy [SIM]
tasks.detail: Stage src/ → build/release, create release ZIP, deploy to the active simulator folder

tasks.label: Lua syntax check (luac -p)
tasks.detail: Compile-check every Lua file under src/
args: $f = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.lua '${workspaceFolder}/src'; $bad = 0; foreach ($x in $f) { luac -p $x.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $bad++ } }; if ($bad -eq 0) { Write-Host "OK: $($f.Count) files" } else { exit 1 }
